review.notes: CHANGES_REQUESTED. The approval-to-candidate-to-evidence-to-REVIEW topology, three-path implementation scope, exact frozen authority and hashes, runtime documents, history/finding controls, ledger-derived successor, deterministic generator, ordinary-authority denial, formatting, lint, and typing all reproduced. Thirteen focused tests passed. One HIGH control failure remains: the public application path accepts a clean worktree whose protected output directory is a Windows junction and writes successor bytes outside the repository, contrary to the packet's redirected-path denial and repository-confined seven-path application contract.

findings.title: Seven-path application follows a clean directory junction outside the repository
findings.reproduction: In a disposable real-Git approved-application fixture, move planning/review-site/recoveries aside, copy its exact predecessor bytes to an external temporary directory, and create a Windows directory junction at the canonical recoveries path targeting that external directory. `git diff --name-only HEAD --` remains empty; os.path.isjunction reports true for the directory but false for its GRR-0002.html leaf. Invoke the public command_apply with the exact canonical approved state and application evidence. The controller prints `Applied exact seven-path B02 R01 CHANGES_REQUESTED projection`, removes its transaction artifacts, and changes the external GRR-0002.html hash. `_validate_live_pair` checks redirection only on each leaf, while command_apply and `_publish_snapshot` construct final destinations with `repo / relative`; none rejects a redirected ancestor. The later finalization validator uses safe_path and would reject the escaped path, so the accepted application both writes outside repository scope and cannot lawfully finalize. This directly violates acceptance criterion 8's substituted/redirected-path denial and exact seven-path recovery contract.
findings.requiredRemediation: Create a strict-descendant R02 candidate and fresh evidence. Before creating any transaction artifact, and again under the application/recovery lock immediately before publication, validate every component of every FINAL_PATHS destination: reject any symlink or junction/reparse redirection at the leaf or an ancestor and require the resolved destination to remain within the canonical repository. Reuse that invariant in apply, recover, live-pair validation, snapshot publication, predecessor validation, and finalization. Add public command_apply and recover tests using a real Windows parent-directory junction for each affected path family; prove the command fails before changing either the external target or any protected repository byte and that repeated status/recovery remains fail-closed. Preserve this R01 ledger append-only and close the finding only with exact R02 evidence and independent review.

review.notes: APPROVED. R02 is a strict-descendant, two-path remediation whose evidence-only and frozen REVIEW commits are exact. The R01 ledger, evidence, state projection, finding, protected backlog, adverse B02 ledger, and witness remain append-only and byte-exact. The shared guard now validates every root-to-leaf component of all seven final destinations for canonical scope, presence, directory/regular-file type, symlink, junction, Windows reparse metadata, and resolved repository containment. It is enforced before application artifacts, under recovery and publication locks, before each write, after publication, and during predecessor and finalization reads. The exact external-junction exploit is denied before mutation, the five-family public Windows apply/recover matrix and post-publication recheck pass, and the normal interrupted recovery and exact finalization lifecycle remains valid. No new finding remains.

closures.evidence: At candidate 5c9bb0b79350c4c38bb2e1b97312314e8a4f8211, guard_final_destination walks the repository root through every component of each FINAL_PATHS destination and rejects symlink, junction, reparse, escaped, absent, non-directory-parent, and non-regular-leaf states. command_apply invokes the full guard under the backlog lock before authority/evidence staging and again immediately before transaction creation; recover_transaction invokes it under the lock; live-pair validation, each publication write, post-publication verification, predecessor validation, and finalization all reuse it. Independent replay of the original clean planning/review-site/recoveries junction to an external directory produced the component-redirection denial, left every external byte unchanged, and created no transaction artifact. The real five-family public apply/status/recover junction matrix plus post-publication recheck passed in 129.009 seconds, and the interrupted normal application/recovery/direct-child finalization test passed in 92.033 seconds. The immutable R01 ledger still hashes to 850e5e1c186e2de50cfc5f59d671d435945670234b98d3e5857e2089f0a8222a.
